title: Jaɓɓungal Leydi
intro: E jamaanu jarribooji mawɗi, neɗɗo tedduɗo rokkaama ngalu aduna keewngu, jarribo yettoode e neɗɗaagal. Jahgol ngol limre ina waɗi jannde luggiɗnde e sifaa jawdi ndariindi e batte mawnikinaare. Uddit sifaa oo ruuhu mo daartol mum winndaa e nder leydi les men ndii.
clues: Mi hoɗii e leñol ngol nulaaɗo mawɗo ardii.
Alla rokkii kam jawdi keewndi haa ko heewi e coktirgal ngalu am, ko 6uu6ol teeŋtungol wonande yim6e heew6e semmbe.
Yimɓe am, anndude jawdi am, wasiyii kam yoo mi ɗaɓɓu hoɗorde laakara e ko Alla rokki mi koo mi yejjitaa geɗal am e aduna, mi waɗa moƴƴere no Alla waɗiri mi moƴƴere nii.
Miɗo anndi e mawnikinaare wonde ngalu am keewngu ngu keɓ-mi tan ko e ganndal am e tiiɗnaare am, miɗo yedda kala moƴƴere Alla.
Nde naamnaa mi yo mi wallu walla mi jaɓa moƴƴere Alla, mi salii e mawnikinaare, miɗo sikki jawdi am ko miin tan.
Sabu mawnikinaare am e tooñannge am ɓurtunde, Alla yamiri leydi ndii uddita, ɓuuɓna mi e hoɗorde am.
arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍۢ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ
verse: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves. (28:81)
